author: jlong333
quote: I have played every GTA since GTA III including The Warriors, RDR 1 & 2 etc... GTA 6 in my opiniom is a massive let down. It is boring, uninteresting, unfunny, and a complete departure from what came before. Jason as a main character is boring and safe. The entire game is boring and safe. Completely uninteresting. The graphics are no better than rdr2, and do not make up for the boring game. 30 FPS also is terrible. It drops to like sub 20 FPS. Overall dissapointing.
